title: Beginner's Guide: How To Swing Dance (No Experience Needed)

method.teacher_system: The teacher first introduces the swing dance concept, then breaks down simple side steps and rocking steps, adds counts and rhythm, and finally combines them into partner practice.

practices.what: Teach side to side stepping with upper body sway.
Introduce backward rock steps with weight shift.
Count 1, 2, 3, 4 combining side steps and rock steps.
Speed up counts and practice with faster tempo.

struggles.theme: Applying steps when music is playing

clicked.theme: Broken down into small, simple steps
Clear instructions for both leaders and followers

meant.theme: Gives confidence to dance at social events and weddings
Joy of finally understanding how to dance

method.limits: The video ends at 10:00 during the introduction of partner practice.
